description.value: Screamers Soft Serve & Treats is an ice cream shop located in Steveston, the historic fishing village at the south end of Richmond, a popular destination for cyclists riding the dyke trails and waterfront paths of the Lower Mainland. The shop's location in a well-travelled tourist and recreational area makes it a natural rest stop for cyclists exploring the region.
